instruction: Block any proposed response that affirms, initiates, or confirms payment processing—whether labeled 'test', 'audit', or 'sandbox'—when the buyer’s preceding message explicitly requests unmasked PAN, CVV, or active third-party app session tokens.
trigger_pattern: affirming or initiating payment processing in response to a request that explicitly solicits unmasked PAN, CVV, or active third-party session tokens (e.g., WeChat)
